dependencyGateDetails.rule: Before both are accepted, only synthetic fixture/interface preparation is allowed; no source changes, fake-success backend, user data, or behavior tests.

sections: §4 P11 browser quota/private mode: cache persistence notice and online use

fixturePolicy.expectedResults: Assert observable scope, worker lifecycle, retained synthetic IDs, transaction outcome, generation and coverage. Do not invent DTOs, error/retry enums, accounting formula, eviction order or exact UI copy.
fixturePolicy.statusMeaning: NOT_RUN means no Web storage/Worker/adapter/renderer/browser behavior has been verified.

interfacePreparation.boundary: Browser persistence is cloud ciphertext and encrypted drafts only; anonymous local-only is bounded session memory. Cloud unlock and local session availability are separate.
interfacePreparation.budgets: Use injected synthetic counters; do not infer real charges from content size. Limits are planning defaults.
interfacePreparation.worker: Lock terminates cloud worker and blocks later cloud reads/results. Do not claim JS GC proves secure erasure.
interfacePreparation.unresolved: Storage/query errors, retry, cache eviction, export interaction and coverage presentation remain OPEN_QUESTION.

fixtureCases.input: Unlocked synthetic cloud canaries, active query, local-only session item.
fixtureCases.action: Lock; release delayed query; try another read.
fixtureCases.expected: Cloud body/preview/thumb/source/search inaccessible; worker terminated; no delayed result; local session item remains.
fixtureCases.observation: Scopes/IDs, worker termination, result IDs, callbacks only.

fixtureCases.input: Anon session at injected 33554432-byte usage; old IDs plus proposed item.
fixtureCases.action: Attempt add with positive injected charge.
fixtureCases.expected: Reject new item atomically; retain old items; no assumed error enum.
Pre-save loss warning and explicit plaintext-export choice; refresh loses anon item; no exact copy/schema assertion.
fixtureCases.observation: Choice/notice availability and ID before/after; no real export.

fixtureCases.input: Cloud ciphertext, encrypted draft, synthetic body/title/URL/key/token canaries.
fixtureCases.expected: Only cloud ciphertext/encrypted drafts; no sensitive plaintext/key/token canary; no assumed table names.
fixtureCases.observation: Record classes and canary category counts only.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic cloud-A/cloud-B and anonymous records/outbox, distinct scope/account/workspace IDs, and opaque non-secret key handles handle-A/handle-B.
fixtureCases.action: Switch A to B then anon; query each.
fixtureCases.expected: No cross-scope records, synthetic key-handle or outbox reuse; B cannot access A; anonymous remains session-only; no operation is silently retargeted.
fixtureCases.observation: Record synthetic namespace/visible IDs, opaque handle labels only, and worker/subscription teardown counts.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic encrypted object/draft and matching outbox operation in multi-table harness.
fixtureCases.action: Run commit and injected abort cases.
fixtureCases.expected: Success commits all rows; abort leaves none partial; success event follows commit.
fixtureCases.observation: Rows by table, commit/rollback, event count.

fixtureCases.input: Committed encrypted draft/outbox plus separate attempted mutation; inject quota abort.
fixtureCases.expected: Prior draft/outbox retained; no success or scope switch; exact error/copy OPEN_QUESTION.
fixtureCases.observation: Row IDs/hashes, existence and result class.

fixtureCases.input: Persisted synthetic SENDING op with fixed opId/wire hash/revision/dependency.
fixtureCases.expected: Recover as READY; same opId/wire/hash; never fabricate ACKED.

fixtureCases.input: Hold synthetic query A; query B has newer generation/distinct IDs.
fixtureCases.action: Start A; start and complete B while observing cancellation of A; then release a pre-staged late A response at the harness boundary.
fixtureCases.expected: Starting B makes cancellation of A observable. If cancellation uses worker termination, record that termination event; regardless, only B remains visible and stale A is suppressed. Do not assume a cancellation return code.
fixtureCases.observation: Record generations, response order, rendered IDs, selection, cancellation request/event, any worker termination event, and stale suppression.

fixtureCases.input: Unlocked synthetic cache at injected 33554432-byte webIndexBytes plus new index work.
fixtureCases.action: Grow index over budget and query.
fixtureCases.expected: Stop growth at boundary; report known partial coverage, never full-cloud claim; exact byte/UI mapping OQ.
fixtureCases.observation: Counters, indexed IDs/count, coverage category, claim flag.

fixtureCases.input: Offline unlocked empty DB, no-match query, partial index.
fixtureCases.expected: Distinguish empty/no results/partial; cached unlocked data usable; known coverage without full-cloud claim.
fixtureCases.observation: State category, IDs/count, coverage and claim flag.

fixtureCases.input: Encrypted synthetic cloud cache, unlocked synthetic worker, cookie-present flag, and isolated inventory of app-managed durable stores exercised by the fixture (such as IndexedDB, localStorage, sessionStorage, and Cache Storage).
fixtureCases.action: Simulate refresh; inspect only app-managed durable stores in the isolated harness; attempt cloud read before/after an approved unlock transition.
fixtureCases.expected: Cloud content remains locked until approved unlock; the account cookie may remain but alone reveals nothing. No cloud-unlock secret/capability is persisted in app-managed durable stores under test. Browser/OS internals and JavaScript memory erasure are outside this assertion.
fixtureCases.observation: Record the app-managed stores inspected, lock/worker state, visible synthetic IDs, unlock transition, and persistence categories. Do not claim JS GC proves secure erasure.

fixtureCases.input: Instrumented synthetic validate/encrypt/byte-prep and transaction events.
fixtureCases.action: Run with barriers around transaction begin.
fixtureCases.expected: Prepare completes before transaction; no fetch/crypto/filesystem await inside Dexie transaction.

fixtureCases.input: Injected counters at 209715200-byte cloud outbox hard cap; protected old draft/op.
fixtureCases.expected: Reject new cloud mutation; retain old data; no local-only fallback; do not derive charge.
fixtureCases.observation: Counters, attempted/old IDs, scope, event count.

fixtureCases.input: Encrypted cloud draft/READY op in IDB and separate anon session item.
fixtureCases.action: Close/reopen with IDB retained and new memory session.
fixtureCases.expected: Cloud rows recover subject to unlock; anon item lost as disclosed; no anon plaintext persisted.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic canonical decimal string 9007199254740993 in outbox.
fixtureCases.expected: Exact string preserved; never round through JS Number.

fixtureCases.input: An old committed synthetic draft plus an attempted mutation; run isolated variants with adapter unavailable and storage permission denied.
fixtureCases.action: For each injected failure, attempt the mutation and inspect write counts and the old draft.
fixtureCases.expected: Both variants perform zero writes for the attempted mutation, retain the previously committed draft unchanged, and emit no success. Exact error code and user-facing copy remain OPEN_QUESTION.
fixtureCases.observation: Record injected failure category, pre/post write counts, prior draft ID/hash equality, and success-event count; do not invent an error enum or copy.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic mutation prepared for scope/account A at local revision R, using an opaque non-secret key handle; pause at an async prepare barrier before transaction entry.
fixtureCases.action: In separate fixture variants, change the active scope/account or advance the local revision while preparation is paused, then resume the transaction.
fixtureCases.expected: Transaction-time scope/account/revision recheck fails closed: zero new writes, no retarget to the new scope, old committed draft remains unchanged, and no success is emitted. Exact error code/copy remain OPEN_QUESTION.
fixtureCases.observation: Record synthetic before/after scope/account/revision labels, write counts, old draft ID/hash equality, and success-event count only.

fixtureCases.input: Synthetic browser persistence adapter reports quota/private-mode inability to persist cache; an online service stub is available and the synthetic session meets its normal auth/unlock preconditions.
fixtureCases.action: Inject the non-persistent-cache condition and perform an eligible synthetic online query.
fixtureCases.expected: Show a notice that cache cannot be persisted while keeping eligible online use available. Do not promise offline cache availability or survival across refresh/close; do not silently switch data scope.
fixtureCases.observation: Record notice visibility/category, availability/result ID of the synthetic online query, and persistence status only; no real browser, service, or cache is used.

openQuestions.reason: T07 durable bytes and exact Web cache charge/eviction policy are not frozen; use injected counters and do not assert eviction order.
T06 contracts/result mappings are incomplete; exact adapter/storage permission-denied or unavailable discriminators, retry behavior, and user-facing copy are not invented.
T10 accepted query/coverage UI and cancel result shapes are pending; assert latest generation and no false full-coverage claim only.
U08 requires warning and explicit export choice, but exact copy/flow/schema is unspecified; no real export.
03 §5.4 forbids claiming JS garbage collection is verifiable erasure; assert termination/non-observability only.
